notes: v3.66.32 (Sep: 'Cap them quyen sua/xoa/tra ve cho KTT trong moi khoan phai tra/chi ho - moi trang thai den duyet L1 - cua KTT'): TIM RA 2 lo hong that trong wfCanEdit()/wfCanDelete() (dung chung cho ca AP va Chi ho - wfCanDelete(t) dung o dong 52631 cho opTransactions xac nhan): (1) wfCanEdit - truoc day CHI CHINH NGUOI TAO sua duoc o draft/rejected (KTT khong sua duoc phieu NV khac tao), va CHI ADMIN sua duoc o pending_acc/pending_l1 (tru khi phieu duoc tra ve dung cap qua _rejectBackTo) - KTT hoan toan bi khoa 2 trang thai nay du la canApproveL1. (2) wfCanDelete - truong tu chi cho XOA dung ban ghi cua CHINH MINH tao, KTT khong xoa duoc bat ky ai khac. Da sua ca 2: them dieu kien canApproveL1() && ['draft','rejected','pending_acc','pending_l1'].includes(status) -> tra true, cho phep KTT sua/xoa MOI ban ghi (khong rieng cua minh) o 4 trang thai nay - dung ranh gioi 'den duyet L1' Sep neu, KHONG mo rong sang pending_l2/approved. 'Tra ve' (reject) da hoat dong dung qua man Phe duyet co san (canCheckAcc+canApproveL1 da cho xem ca 2 cap pending_acc/pending_l1), khong can sua them.
